_comment: PT tournament slot id (first 3 digits of an event id) -> the filer's series slug. Built by reading ids off the Your Tournaments screen; grows every capture. An event id is <slot><4-digit run>, so 2110168 = slot 211 run 168 = tryinglookbusy_168.csv. This is what removes hand-typed run numbers.
_source: read from OOTP's Your Tournaments list 2026-08-31; slugs from File OOTP Exports.command
